summary: This directory provides mechanisms for translating and interpreting variables within specific market contexts. It serves as a central hub for handling dynamic data parsing and variable resolution logic required for application-wide consistency.
responsibilities: Parse variables from external data inputs
Interpret and format date values within specific market contexts
Provide centralized translation services for dynamic data
relationships: The Variable Translator service utilizes market context settings to accurately parse and transform variable data.
Date parsing logic is integrated within the variable translator to ensure data format compliance across different markets.
designDecisions: Encapsulation of translation logic within a dedicated service class
Centralization of market-specific data processing to ensure consistency
Use of a unified interface for variable and date handling
